findings.issue: Hiphil 3ms brings the 3ms suffix; עד is a separate witness noun, not the bringer. “lo traerá testigo” makes testigo the subject who brings it.
הַטְּרֵפָה is the feminine noun fronted before piel 3ms “he shall not repay”; the torn thing is not the one who pays. “el desgarrado no pagará” makes it the subject.
Qal infinitive absolute plus niphal imperfect repeats the same tearing for emphasis. “desgarrando” can be read as a separate manner gerund.

notes: Si, the negative, and future pagará match אם, לא, and the piel imperfect; the subject of that verb does not.
